name: Gradaly v4.0.3
title: Gradaly v4.0.3
notes:
### Improvements & Fixes
- **Academic License Activation & Network Diagnostics**: Migrated the academic license authority to `portal.gradaly.io` with automatic fallback, added native OS root certificate support (`rustls-tls-native-roots`) for enterprise proxies/firewalls, and introduced an interactive network diagnostic & troubleshooting assistant when a local firewall or antivirus blocks activation.
- **AI Grading Settings**: Updated the recommended OpenAI model to `gpt-5.6-sol`, simplified the model selector with a direct link to https://benchlm.ai/compare, and increased the maximum parallel grading workers limit up to 64.
